newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-MIDDLESBROUGH DOCKED THREE POINTS AND FINED.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-MIDDLESBROUGH DOCKED THREE POINTS AND FINED.

text.p: English premier league club Middlesbrough have been docked three points and fined 50,000 pounds ($83,300) for pulling out of a scheduled fixture against Blackburn last month, a league spokesman said on Tuesday.
Middlesbrough, who were already bottom of the league, dropped to 15 points, four points behind nearest club Southampton.
Middlesbrough called off the fixture, scheduled for December 21,saying too many of their players were ill.
But a lengthy league disciplinary panel hearing which was attended by manager Brian Robson concluded they "did not have just cause for unilaterally calling off the match."
The league said Middlesbrough had the right to appeal and the match would be rearranged.
